stock.description: China Uptown Group Company Limited functions as an investment holding firm, primarily dedicated to investing in and developing real estate properties throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's business activities are divided into two main divisions: Property Development and Investment, and Raw Cane Sugar Trading. Under its property segment, it undertakes the construction and marketing of various types of real estate, including commercial and residential buildings, as well as parking spaces. Furthermore, the group is involved in the trade of raw cane sugar and offers management solutions. Established in 2000, its central office is situated in Tsimshatsui, Hong Kong.
